draws.answer: A chief information officer (CIO) is the senior C-suite executive responsible for information technology within an organization; it is an internal-facing role. A CIO must possess deep knowledge of information technology and business processes—either alone is insufficient. CIOs direct the information technology organization, setting ongoing policies while also defining and executing significant initiatives under the direction of the CEO.

Time series is data recorded over time, such as stock prices or weather temperatures. [Ch. 5]
Asked as: "What is Time Series?"

Time series is a series of values organized by time. For example, stock prices might move as trades are executed throughout the day, or a weather sensor will take atmospheric temperatures every minute. Any events that are recorded over time—either regularly or sporadically—are time-series data. A time-series database is optimized for retrieving and statistical processing of time-series data.

Streaming ingestion processes data continuously and in real-time, providing data to downstream systems as soon as it is produced. Batch is often chosen for use cases where data timeliness is not critical, such as model training and weekly reporting.

ETL stands for extract, transform, load. From [Ch. 1]. ELT is described as a pattern where data gets moved more or less directly from production systems into a staging area in the data warehouse. Staging indicates raw data. Transformations are handled in the data warehouse. This is from [Ch. 3].

ETL stands for extract, transform, load. From [Ch. 1]. ELT is a variation on ETL where data gets moved more or less directly from production systems into a staging area in the data warehouse. Staging in this setting indicates that the data is in a raw form. Rather than using an external system, transformations are handled directly in the data warehouse. The intention is to take advantage of the massive computational power of cloud data warehouses and data processing tools. Data is processed in batches, and transformed output is written into tables and views for analytics. Figure 3-11 shows the general process. ELT is also popular in a streaming arrangement, as events are streamed from a CDC process, stored in a staging area, and then subsequently transformed within the data warehouse. From [Ch. 3].

draws.asked_as: What is benefits of data meshs?
draws.answer:
Data mesh changes how data is served within an organization by making every domain team responsible for both serving data to other teams and consuming data from other teams. This means that domain teams prepare data for consumption by other parts of the organization and also run their own dashboards and analytics.
Asked as: "What is benefits of data meshs?"

draws.asked_as: What is benefits of data meshs?
draws.answer:
Data mesh changes how data is served within an organization by making every domain team responsible for both serving data to other teams and consuming data from other teams. This means that instead of having siloed data teams, each domain team handles both providing data for apps and analytics and consuming data needed for their own purposes.
Asked as: "What is benefits of data meshs?"
